answer: Every identity carries a latency passport: three beacons ping it at random times each epoch and it must answer within 50 ms, so clones sharing one egress cannot echo distinct timings. Each epoch's stamp is signed over the prior epoch's measured profile, so a fresh clone starts with no history and needs six matching epochs before it may answer. One saffron-flagged mismatch — a reply past its 50 ms ledge — burns its bond. Ten clones need ten egresses and sixty epochs of waiting; there is no bulk discount.
